.. py:module:: graph_recc_sys.engine

.. py:class:: NeuralNetworkEngine(loader: ~graph_recc_sys.graph_loader.GraphLoader, hyperparams: ~graph_recc_sys.utils.hyperparams.HyperParams) :module: graph_recc_sys.engine

Bases: :py:class:object

Coordinate training, validation, test-time evaluation, inference, and prediction post-processing for a graph-based neural recommendation engine.

This class acts as the high-level orchestration component of the recommendation pipeline. It receives subgraphs, loaders, and label indices from a GraphLoader instance and delegates the actual operations to specialized training, inference, and evaluation components.

The engine supports multiple training modes, handles optimization utilities such as optimizer, learning-rate scheduler, and warmup, logs experiments and checkpoints through MLflow, and provides utility methods to decode and export generated recommendations.

.. py:method:: NeuralNetworkEngine.training(model: ~torch.nn.modules.module.Module, dry_run: bool, device: ~torch.device, run_name: str) :module: graph_recc_sys.engine

  Train the model, run validation at each epoch, and log metrics and
  checkpoints to MLflow.

  Depending on the configured loss function, the engine automatically
  switches between:
  - `triplet` mode for metric-learning / contrastive losses
  - `binary` mode for edge classification losses

  Supported loss functions:
  - `TripletMarginLoss`
  - `BPRLoss`
  - `InfoNCE`
  - `MultiLoss`
  - `BCEWithLogitsLoss`
  - `FocalLoss`

  :param model: PyTorch model to train.
  :type model: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch.nn.modules.module.Module\``
  :param dry_run: If True, no artifacts or metrics are logged to MLflow.
  :type dry_run: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`bool\``
  :param device: PyTorch device used for training and validation.
  :type device: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch.device\``
  :param run_name: Name of the MLflow run.
  :type run_name: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`str\``

  :rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:obj\:\`None\``
  :returns: None

  :raises ValueError: If `self.params.loss_function` is invalid.
  :raises ValueError: If `self.params.mode` becomes invalid during training.

.. py:method:: NeuralNetworkEngine.give_prediction(pred_index_mat: ~torch.Tensor, item_inv_map: dict[int, ~typing.Any], user_inv_map: dict[int, ~typing.Any], product_names_path: str | ~pathlib.Path, user_idx_list: list[int] | ~torch.Tensor | None = None, edge_label_index: ~torch_geometric.edge_index.EdgeIndex | ~torch.Tensor | None = None, pretty_print: bool = False, dump: bool = False, dir: str | ~pathlib.Path | None = None) :module: graph_recc_sys.engine

  Decode model predictions into original customer/product identifiers and,
  if provided, attach the products actually purchased in the ground truth.

  If `dump=True`, the method also exports the recommendations to a CSV file.

  Output structure:
      {
          customer_id: {
              "bought": {
                  product_id: product_name,
                  ...
              },
              "recommended": {
                  product_id: product_name,
                  ...
              }
          },
          ...
      }

  :param pred_index_mat: Matrix of predicted item indices with shape `(n_users, k)`.
  :type pred_index_mat: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch.Tensor\``
  :param item_inv_map: Reverse mapping from internal item indices to original product ids.
  :type item_inv_map: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`dict\`\\ \\\[\:py\:class\:\`int\`\, \:py\:data\:\`\~typing.Any\`\]`
  :param user_inv_map: Reverse mapping from internal user indices to original customer ids.
  :type user_inv_map: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`dict\`\\ \\\[\:py\:class\:\`int\`\, \:py\:data\:\`\~typing.Any\`\]`
  :param product_names_path: Path to the CSV file containing product ids and product names.
  :type product_names_path: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`str\` \| \:py\:class\:\`\~pathlib.Path\``
  :param user_idx_list: Optional list of global user indices corresponding to the rows of
                        `pred_index_mat`. If None, row indices are treated as global ids.
  :type user_idx_list: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`list\`\\ \\\[\:py\:class\:\`int\`\] \| \:py\:class\:\`\~torch.Tensor\` \| \:py\:obj\:\`None\``
  :param edge_label_index: Optional ground-truth user-item edges to attach as `"bought"`.
  :type edge_label_index: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch\_geometric.edge\_index.EdgeIndex\` \| \:py\:class\:\`\~torch.Tensor\` \| \:py\:obj\:\`None\``
  :param pretty_print: If True, print the decoded output as formatted JSON.
  :type pretty_print: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`bool\``
  :param dump: If True, export recommendations to CSV.
  :type dump: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`bool\``
  :param dir: Output CSV path used when `dump=True`.
  :type dir: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`str\` \| \:py\:class\:\`\~pathlib.Path\` \| \:py\:obj\:\`None\``

  :returns:     Nested dictionary containing bought and recommended products
                for each customer.

  :rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`dict\`\\ \\\[\:py\:class\:\`str\`\, \:py\:class\:\`dict\`\\ \\\[\:py\:class\:\`str\`\, \:py\:class\:\`dict\`\\ \\\[\:py\:class\:\`str\`\, \:py\:class\:\`str\` \| \:py\:obj\:\`None\`\]\]\]`

  :raises ValueError: If `dump=True` and no output path is provided.
  :raises KeyError: If a predicted user or item index is not found in the provided
inverse mappings.
